inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: In multiple classrooms it was observed there was chipping of paint and sheetrock. There was also dirt and debris observed on classroom walls. In a specific classroom there was a hole in the sheetrock between the sizes of a nickel and a quarter that was accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: There were 4 caregivers that did not have all required annual training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: It was observed that six inches of  loose-fill surfacing is needed on both playgrounds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The following observed outside on the playground during inspection:  Broken plastic box that have sharp edges; Tangle / broken soccer netting on the ground and by the frame; a plier and two metal pieces on the ground by a classroom door that accessible to children; a broken couch by an open toy box; and a metal garden hand rake that accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: It was observed that six inches of  loose-fill surfacing is needed on both playgrounds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left alone in the outside playground for approximately  minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver was witnessed pulling a child by the hair to force them to stand up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was seen yelling at a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feeding instructions were not updated monthly as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual sanitation inspection was expired by the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Infant bottles were not labeled with the child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: The operation did not notify licensing of a change in the director in writing by the required 5 days of the change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensed Operations Required Fees: The operation has failed to pay outstanding background check fees.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensed Operations Required Fees (26 TAC §745.509)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant classroom was indicated, on sign-in sheets, to be out of ratio in the mornings for an average of 10-20 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: I observed children under 2 years old watching a cartoon.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 of the 10 children's records were missing updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Notice-Keeping Children Safe: Operation was missing the Keeping Children Safe poster.  This was corrected at inspection when the director posted it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Notice-Keeping Children Safe (26 TAC §746.401(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 3 of the 10 staff records reviewed were missing the notarized Employee Affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and was deficient based on the preponderance of evidence. A caregiver placed her leg on top of a child in attempt to make them be still and take a nap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: 2 children with diagnosed food allergies are missing a food allergy emergency plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Parent May Not Authorize in Excess of Label Directions or Child's Health-Care Professional Directions: 3 infant parents have instructed to give medication when the label states to ask a doctor for their age range.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Parent May Not Authorize in Excess of Label Directions or Child's Health-Care Professional Directions (26 TAC §746.3803(c))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: I observed medication that is expired and no longer used present at the operation during my inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: A current fire inspection was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: A bottle was left unlabeled, and it resulted in an infant getting fed the wrong bottle.   Bottles were observed to be labeled during my visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Not Under the Influence of Alcohol or Controlled Substance: Based on information gathered it was determined there is reasonable evidence to believe a caregiver was under the influence of alcohol while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Not Under the Influence of Alcohol or Controlled Substance (26 TAC §746.3703(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The playground equipment on the toddler playground is chipping in several places. This is exposing raw wood that children have directo access to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: 3 caregivers stated that they have observed infants sleeping in restrictive devices. 2 caregivers stated that they let infants sleep in restrictive devices for a period of time to ensure they were asleep before moving them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Toys and Equipment to be Sanitized Set Aside: 4 caregivers express concern as toys are often visibly dirty and are concerned that the toys are not being cleaned. 1 caregiver stated that she sprays the toys with bleach water, but do not wipe them down and she does not do the deep clean on Friday afternoons as it seems overwhelming.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Toys and Equipment to be Sanitized Set Aside (26 TAC §746.3407(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: 3 caregivers, who work out of ratio, stated that they often work out of ratio for an extended amount of time because one teacher is late.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: I observed 2 highchairs in the infant 2 classroom without safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The CPSC form was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The training records for 10 of 10 reviewed files were not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: The current proof of liability insurance was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: The safety documentation was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 of the 10 children's records needs updated shot records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: There are 7 children present without updated infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was an individual present and caring for children without an eligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: The facility did not report positive cases of COVID within the two day time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))
